name: Milcah
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the Lord commanded Moses: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah married their father's brothers' sons, within the families of Manasseh, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

note.label: Numbers 36: The Inheritance of the Daughters of Zelophehad

points: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

note.label: Joshua 17: The Lot of Manasseh and the Blessing of Ephraim
